collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager takes a shortcut and comes out covered in burrs: ask the children to help, or pick them off yourself.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) took a shortcut through the long grass beyond the gardens and has come out the other side covered in burrs: hundreds of little hooked seeds, stuck to (subject.his/her) clothes, (subject.his/her) hair, and everything else. (subject.He/she) looks like a very large, very surprised seed pod.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The children pick them off one at a time, counting out loud. They get to four hundred and twelve. Then (child), a child, finds one more behind (subject)'s ear. "FOUR HUNDRED AND THIRTEEN!" There is great cheering. (subject) takes the long way round from now on.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: Every burr (subject) pulls off sticks to (subject.his/her) fingers, then to the other hand, then back onto (subject.his/her) clothes. After an hour (subject.he/she) has moved most of them from one place to another. (friend) watches for a while, then fetches a comb. "Hold still," (friend.he/she) says, and gets to work.
